keyword.en: electric 50 vs low pressure 40 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的区别

title.zh: 电动50和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Low Pressure 40 prints one fine-stone pair and Kawasaki 112. Electric 50 prints three stone rows and Kawasaki 140.
description.zh: 低压40只印一组细石距离和川崎112。电动50印三行石子距离和川崎140。

h1.zh: 电动50和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 50 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine-stone 80 m / 240 m. Electric 50 prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine-stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Keep each stone row on the page that prints it.
directAnswer.zh: 电动50和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。低压40印 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 80 m / 240 m。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。80 m / 240 m 在低压40是唯一的距离，在电动50是中间那一行石子距离。

heading.en: Where Electric 50 and Electric Low Pressure 40 print different values
heading.zh: 电动50和电动低压40哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 50 prints 55 kW; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 12–15 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 50 prints 30 MPa; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 20 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 50 prints 0.4 m³; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 0.3 m³. Hydraulic pump: Electric 50 prints Kawasaki 140; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints Kawasaki 112. Dimensions: Electric 50 prints 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动50印 55 kW；电动低压40印 37 kW。理论输送量：电动50印 26 m³/h；电动低压40印 12–15 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动50印 30 MPa；电动低压40印 20 MPa。料斗容积：电动50印 0.4 m³；电动低压40印 0.3 m³。液压泵：电动50印 Kawasaki 140；电动低压40印 Kawasaki 112。外形尺寸：电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm；电动低压40印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 50 prints cells that Electric Low Pressure 40 does not: Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints cells that Electric 50 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动50有、电动低压40没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。电动低压40有、电动50没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A repeated metre pair is not the same row unless the heading matches. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 一组米数重复出现，也不等于同一行，除非标题一致。看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看电动低压40请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 55 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 55 kW。电动低压40印 37 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same theoretical output as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 12–15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 26 m³/h。电动低压40印 12–15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动50和电动低压40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 30 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 30 MPa。电动低压40印 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is fine-stone conveying (h / v) missing on Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动低压40没有细石输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric Low Pressure 40 page does not print that label. Electric 50 prints 150 m / 350 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动低压40这一页没有印这个标题。电动50印的是 150 m / 350 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
